categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_eviction.py to accurately test p2p peer eviction protection (SelectNodeToEvict).
categories.rationale: Ensures p2p eviction tests actually test block-time protection instead of passing due to connection-time fallback. As demonstrated by the author, 'With this change the test fails if the CompareNodeBlockTime protection in SelectNodeToEvict is removed', catching regressions in peer DoS eviction safeguards.
